remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature [note of inscription 1 but with 'Four' instead of '4']. Note: O'Keeffe thinks apple group ptd. ab. 1921." Backing inscription dates 1920. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1921. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 12, 20. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
